contracts/test/UpgradeAuthorityPrediction.t.sol:28-72 checks CREATE2 prediction only, scripts/ci/check-timelock-prediction-parity.ts:27-45 recomputes it, and publish-contracts/src/verify/fund.ts:240 checks a manifest string written by the deploy script; none reads on-chain EXECUTOR_ROLE holders
docs/runbooks/contract-qa/releases/v0.7.0-onevault.yaml:548-562 executes the fund dry-run only in a human rehearsal with onlyFor=rehearsal and maxMinutes=60
findings.impact: Assertion integrity: the Safe-only executor property is not proven by an executed CI assertion, so a regression in the fund handover could leave CI green with only the deploy-time require and human QA readback to catch it. No wrong artifact was observed and the deploy gate fails loudly.
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded CI job that deploys the fund stages, executes DeployFundTimelock.run() and reads back EXECUTOR_ROLE with a non-zero executed-test floor; keep the item on the release owner's pre-flight checklist until then. Do not treat prediction, parity or manifest-string checks as closing this gap.
